title: Directs the Oregon Public Defense Commission to study ways to improve the provision of public defense services within this state, and to provide the results of the study to the appropriate interim committees of the Legislative Assembly no later than December 31, 2026.

claims.text: SB 253 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
